answer: Cross-epoch behaviour threading. Each identity carries a thread of prior-epoch action fingerprints; a new epoch's activity must statistically match that thread within a tolerance. A relic of any past epoch can be replayed to reconstruct the expected profile. Mismatches flag the identity, and a plume of anomalous epochs accumulates until rejection. Attacker cost: each sybil must sustain a distinct, self-consistent history across epochs, multiplying work and storage per identity.
